bmo.description: Whether the room's agent plays as the robot, and how hard; normal where not given.

chat.description: The room, by chat id, where it is not this turn's own.

manner.description: Refuse words nothing can follow, the game's one-hit words.

seconds.description: A time limit on each move in seconds, 10 to 120, given only where the room asks for one; with none a turn waits for the player's word.

starter.description: The sender id of the person who asked, who joins at once.

starter_name.description: That person's name as the room shows it.

word.description: A word the asker already said to begin with: the game opens on it, and the player after them moves first. Where it cannot open a game, the service asks the asker in the room for another and opens on that.
